title: After-sales — customer tickets
help: The customer received the order and comes back with a problem. The ticket is « Waiting »; the manager settles it with an exchange (colour / size, other product or parts): the order goes straight to the Depot in « To prepare ». The ticket becomes « Delivered » by itself once the livreur hands it over.

k.livraisonSub: with the courier or the livreur
